title: Exact profiled leverage stability bound
statement: At a one-point exchange-stable Ds state, every admissible move satisfies s_aa - s_bb <= beta q_aa q_bb <= w_i q_aa q_bb (efficient-semimetric violation bounded by the product of full-metric leverages); no balancedness or mass margin needed, complementing DS-OKN-BOUND.
assumptions: positive weights; nonsingular I and nuisance block at the current state (merged atoms NOT required; audited exhaustively with unmerged duplicates)
admissible moves preserve nonempty cells: non-singleton source with positive co-weight (W_a > w_i)
moves with singular post-move states are covered: a singular destination nuisance block forces singular I' (Fischer), and the bound there needs no stability input

proof_location.section: DS13. Exact profiled leverage stability bound

role: finite half of the finite-to-population bridge
